verdict.rationale: Apify's platform supports running Actors via API/SDK (apify-docs-15,16), scheduling and webhooks to chain runs (apify-docs-6,14), proxy rotation to avoid blocking at scale (apify-docs-8), and monitoring/alerting for performance (apify-docs-7) — all consistent with running many concurrent scraping jobs. However, there is no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, autoscaling behavior, or a customer case study demonstrating large-scale parallel runs. missing for 10: explicit concurrency/autoscaling docs, independent benchmark or case study of large-scale concurrent scraping.
